extend_action_space: extend the HabitatSimActions singleton to register a new custom action name and get its integer ID
has_action: check if a given action name is already registered in the HabitatSimActions singleton
get_action_value: get the integer value of a registered action by name using attribute or item access on HabitatSimActions
review_v0_action_space: review the HabitatSimV0ActionSpaceConfiguration class that defines stop, move_forward, turn_left, and turn_right actions
review_v1_action_space: review the HabitatSimV1ActionSpaceConfiguration class that extends v0 with look_up and look_down tilt actions
